## This week

- What a blood pressure reading is
- Our study: 300 participants, up to four visits
- Comparing two treatment arms over time

## Mean systolic pressure by visit

```{python}
means = visits.groupby(["visit_number", "treatment"])["systolic_bp"].mean().unstack()
ax = means.plot(marker="o", figsize=(7, 4), xticks=means.index,
                xlabel="Visit", ylabel="Mean systolic BP (mmHg)")
plt.show()
```
